claim: Quattro Passi holds two Michelin stars and sits in Nerano, Massa Lubrense.
quote: Quattro Passi — Massa Lubrense — Guida Michelin

claim: Quattro Passi is at Via Amerigo Vespucci 13/N, Nerano; second star awarded in 2012; reached via the road from Massa Lubrense to Marina del Cantone.
quote: Via Amerigo Vespucci 13/N, Nerano, Massa Lubrense. This distinguished eatery garnered its second Michelin star in 2012.

claim: Sorrento to Marina del Cantone is ~9 miles, ~21–24 min by taxi, fares quoted US$70–100.
quote: The fastest way to get from Sorrento to Marina del Cantone is to taxi which takes 24 min and costs $80 - $100.

claim: Sant'Agata sui Due Golfi to Nerano is ~9 km, taxi ~11 min, fares quoted US$12–15.
quote: The fastest way to get from Sant'Agata sui Due Golfi to Nerano is to taxi which takes 11 min and costs $12 - $15.

claim: Le Sirenuse Positano to Nerano is ~14 road-miles, taxi ~32 min at US$190–230.
quote: The fastest way to get from Le Sirenuse, Positano to Nerano is to taxi which takes 32 min and costs $190 - $230.

claim: Quattro Passi Relais offers 7 adults-only rooms with garden or sea-view terraces, 5-minute walk to the centre of Nerano, free parking, on-site restaurant.
quote: Quattro Passi Relais Hotel Nerano includes 7 rooms with views of the sea... The centre of Nerano can be reached within a 5-minute walk.

claim: The Mellino family runs the Quattro Passi restaurant; Antonio Mellino in the kitchen with wife Rita and son Fabrizio.
quote: Quattro Passi restaurant — the Mellino Family

claim: Quattro Passi Restaurant Relais is the Mellinos' guesthouse; few rooms scattered around a Mediterranean garden, 13-minute walk to Marina del Cantone beach.
quote: The hotel has only few rooms, scattered around the magnificent mediterranean garden. The guest house is a 13-minute walk from Marina del Cantone Beach.

claim: Taverna del Capitano in Nerano (Michelin restaurant) operates rooms on the beach with private balconies/terraces and sea views, free breakfast, rooftop terrace.
quote: Taverna del Capitano offers airy rooms with private balconies or terraces overlooking the shimmering Tyrrhenian Sea.

claim: Villarena Relais sits in the Nerano fishing village in beautifully renovated rooms inside a 16th-century building on the tip of the peninsula.
quote: Villarena Relais is located in the fishing village of Nerano on the tip of the peninsula... beautifully renovated rooms in a 16th century building.

claim: Casale Villarena is an 18th-century farmhouse residence in Nerano with apartments, a pool, organic garden and on-site restaurant.
quote: The 18th-century farmhouse offers free parking, an on-site restaurant, and quiet accommodation in the small fishing village of Nerano.

claim: Don Alfonso 1890 Boutique Hotel is a 19th-century house with a fanciful pink/magenta/lime/yellow palette, vaulted ceilings and hand-painted mosaics; includes a pre-Roman tunnel wine cellar.
quote: This renovated 19th-century house features traditional elements, but with a fanciful color scheme — rose, magenta, and bubble-gum pink, with accents in canary yellow, lime green and cherry red.

claim: Don Alfonso 1890 holds one Michelin star in the 2026 Italia guide; on-site restaurant of the boutique hotel.
quote: Don Alfonso 1890 — One Star — MICHELIN 2026

claim: Oasi Olimpia Relais is a 19th-century noble villa converted into a clifftop boutique hotel above Sant'Agata sui Due Golfi with views from the Bay of Naples to the Bay of Salerno.
quote: An elegant villa which was once a noble residence in the 1800's... breathtaking vantage point stretching from the whole of the Bay of Naples to the north to the Bay of Salerno to the south.

claim: Oasi Olimpia Relais is ranked #1 of 12 hotels in Sant'Agata sui Due Golfi on Tripadvisor with 451 reviews.
quote: Ranked #1 of 12 hotels in Sant'Agata sui Due Golfi

claim: Grand Hotel Due Golfi features panoramic Bay-of-Naples views from lounge, infinity pool and sea-view rooms — the namesake 'two gulfs' vantage above Sant'Agata.
quote: Stunning views of the Bay of Naples, the Sorrento Peninsula, and Mount Vesuvius from its plate glass windows...

claim: Grand Hotel Excelsior Vittoria was founded 1834 on volcanic rock above the ruins of Emperor Augustus' villa; the Caruso Suite (room 448) hosted both Enrico Caruso and Lucio Dalla, who wrote the song 'Caruso' there.
quote: Built on volcanic rock above an archaeological site where the villa of the Roman emperor Augustus once stood... A special bond with music led the Grand Hotel Excelsior Vittoria to host the famous tenor Caruso for a long time in room 448.

claim: Excelsior Vittoria has 84 rooms and suites — each unique, with original period furniture and many seafront views — in a 5-star hotel run by the Fiorentino family for five generations.
quote: 180-year-old 5-star hotel features 84 rooms and suites each unique in design with original period furniture and many with almost unbelievable seafront views.

claim: Palazzo Marziale is a 15th-century Catalan-Durazzo palazzo (former Savarese family residence) converted into a Sorrento boutique hotel overlooking the gardens of Piazza San Francesco.
quote: Palazzo Marziale is an elegant boutique hotel in the heart of Sorrento, housed in a stunning 15th century palazzo that was the Savarese family residence for centuries.

claim: Maison La Minervetta is a 12-room cliff-side design hotel above Marina Grande in Sorrento, with rooms overlooking the fisherman's wharf and Gulf of Naples.
quote: The 4 star Hotel La Minervetta sits on the seacliff overlooking Marina Grande... The Maison has 12 breathtaking rooms all overlooking the antique fisherman's wharf Marina Grande and the Gulf of Naples.

claim: Maison La Minervetta uses a Pop-Art red/white/blue palette set by interior-designer owner Marco De Luca, with each room unique and a Lisa Corti collection custom-made for the hotel.
quote: Rendered in a refreshing, Pop Art palette of reds, whites and blues, this small clifftop hotel has been carefully curated by its interior designer owner.

claim: Hotel Belair Sorrento, on the cliffs of Via Capo, reopened 1 April 2026 as a 5-star with 46 sea-view rooms and suites, infinity pool, Calypso restaurant and Oblivion rooftop bar.
quote: Hotel Belair Sorrento has officially opened for the 2026 season... Every one of its 46 rooms and suites boasts unobstructed sea views.

claim: Hotel Belair Sorrento is a 5-star sea-view hotel on Via Capo, Sorrento.
quote: 5-star Luxury Hotel Belair – Sorrento – sea view rooms and suites

claim: Hotel Capo La Gala is a 5-star cliff-built hotel in Vico Equense, between Pompeii and Sorrento, with sea-edge terraces and a Michelin restaurant.
quote: Hotel Capo La Gala in Vico Equense — official website

claim: Capo La Gala has 22 rooms and suites, a heated sea-water pool, thalassotherapy spa, and a Michelin-starred restaurant on a sea-hanging terrace.
quote: The hotel features 22 rooms and suites with magnificent outdoor decks and private pools.

claim: Relais Blu is a Termini (Massa Lubrense) clifftop boutique with 11 rooms, infinity pool facing Capri, and an on-site Michelin-starred restaurant.
quote: Relais Blu — Boutique Hotel & Fine Dining Restaurant — Amalfi Coast

claim: Relais Blu sits on the cliff between Sorrento and Amalfi coasts overlooking the two bays, with 11 contemporary rooms and an infinity pool facing the island of Capri.
quote: Relais Blu has just 11 jaw-droppingly beautiful bedrooms... infinity pool facing the pretty island of Capri.

claim: Le Sirenuse is the historic Sersale-family hotel in central Positano, an 18th-century palazzo converted to a hotel in 1951.
quote: Le Sirenuse — Hotel in Positano — Amalfi Coast, Italy

claim: Le Sirenuse operates the Sirenuse Mare beach club in Nerano — a Positano stay still places its owner's beach club at the same bay as Quattro Passi.
quote: Le Sirenuse Mare — Nerano

claim: Positano taxi services run 24-hour, family-run operations since 1994 — late-dinner returns require pre-booking.
quote: Positano Taxi Service — a family-run service company founded in 1994

claim: Sant'Agata sui Due Golfi sits at 391 m above sea level on the spine of the Sorrentine peninsula with views over both the Bay of Naples and the Bay of Salerno — origin of the 'two gulfs' name.
quote: Sant'Agata sui Due Golfi: the Sorrento hill town with views of the two gulfs
